hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *core/src/octoforge_core/db/migrations/versions/*.py) root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); rel="core/src/octoforge_core/db/migrations/versions/${f##*core/src/octoforge_core/db/migrations/versions/}"; if [ -n "$root" ] && git -C "$root" cat-file -e "HEAD:$rel" 2>/dev/null; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"This Alembic migration already exists in git HEAD (already merged/applied). Create a new migration file instead of editing this one.\"}}"; fi ;; esac; }
